visualCharacteristics.purpose: person profile: portrait, name/title/contact details and a biography in fixed columns

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with one cell holding a heading; then one row per person with three cells [portrait image | name heading, job title, phone and email links list, Read more link | biography paragraphs]; the portrait or biography cell may be omitted

usage: Executive committee bios, office contact and service-page contact person.
reuseGuidance: Use for one or a few people with full details or a bio. For grids of people cards use cards-people; for the compact contact card use profile-contact.
